name: Link's Awakening dual screen
_about: Link's Awakening (Switch) dual-screen companion: bottom-screen map, gear and items pages driven by live game memory. Art is romfs: references into the player's own game files and composites of them; the package ships no game art.
_font_fallback: The label font is the game's own jpn_main.bffnt (romfs). If the runtime cannot load a .bffnt, delete the four font keys below: every label then uses the built-in block font at the same text_scale (sizes/positions stay valid, glyph shapes change).
